# National Packers & Movers

> India's premier relocation and logistics enterprise since 1987. Founded by Debabrata Jhampaty, headquartered in Dhanbad, Jharkhand, serving Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Bihar, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, and pan-India destinations.

## Core Relocation Services
- Household Shifting: End-to-end packing, loading, dedicated container transport, unloading, and unpacking.
- Corporate & Office Relocation: Zero-downtime office moving, IT server handling, modular workstation relocation.
- Industrial & Commercial Transport: Heavy plant machinery, factory equipment, raw material logistics.
- Vehicle Relocation: Enclosed car carrier trailers and two-wheeler specialized transport.
- Secure Warehousing: 24/7 CCTV-monitored, moisture-proof short and long-term storage facilities.

## Trust & Compliance Credentials
- Established: 1987 (37+ Years of Continuous Service)
- Founder: Debabrata Jhampaty
- Corporate Compliance: 100% GST-compliant invoices, valid Consignment Notes (LR), official Money Receipts accepted by Coal India (BCCL, ECL, CCL), SAIL, NTPC, SBI, Indian Railways, and Central/State PSUs.
- Fleet: Company-owned lockable weatherproof container trucks. Zero third-party transport brokers.
